# multi-agent-development-workbench

> A local, provider-independent workbench for routing and supervising Claude,
> Codex, Grok, and API-backed coding agents through shared workflows.

spec-first: doc/arch is the source of truth — run `speckit status` then `speckit next` and read the spec before writing any code.

## Start Here

- [Repository guide](AGENTS.md): project structure, commands, gates, and contribution rules
- [Project status](docs/project/STATUS.md): delivered baseline, known gaps, and ordered roadmap
- [Human overview](README.md): product experience and architecture
- [Operator E2E quickstart](docs/operations/operator-e2e-quickstart.md): lock, daemon, session, workflow, VS Code, agent stdio
- [Constitution](doc/arch/memory/constitution.md): non-negotiable design and governance principles
- [Product overview](doc/arch/functional/product-overview.md): actors and end-to-end flow

## Current State

- Run `make context` before relying on this snapshot.
- Authoritative handoff: [docs/project/STATUS.md](docs/project/STATUS.md).
- Features **001–016** are on `main` — monorepo control plane complete; gap-zero
  backlog cleared. Active monorepo work is maintenance / new roadmap only.
- Delivered slice:
  - 001 orchestration kernel, encrypted sessions, config, protocol, daemon, CLI
  - 002 thin VS Code bridge
  - 003 workspace-scoped session discovery and selection
  - 004 supervised Grok Build ACP v1 provider
  - 005 supervised Claude Code subscription adapter
  - 006 supervised Codex subscription adapter
  - 007 central MCP lifecycle, pins, allowlists, approvals
  - 008 configurable multi-agent workflow executor
  - 009 real-time VS Code workflow controls
  - 010 OpenRouter API provider with cost controls
  - 011 Workbench ACP agent stdio bridge MVP (`workbench agent stdio`)
  - 012 ACP agent stdio attach to running daemon endpoint
  - 013 non-loopback HTTPS MCP TLS client
  - 014 durable session cost ledger + opt-in OpenRouter live HTTPS
  - 015 Claude/Codex provider-native write tools under central policy
  - 016 WorkbenchBackend terminal launch surface
- Residual (out of tree, not a monorepo Known Gap): full Grok Build pager
  dual-upstream rebase, PTY suite, and fork SHA pin in
  [grok-build](https://github.com/RenatoTadeuFigueiredo/grok-build).
- Spec and decision anchors for the control plane:
  - [Encrypted storage](doc/arch/adr/0002-encrypted-local-session-storage.md)
  - [Central MCP](doc/arch/adr/0008-central-mcp-lifecycle-and-tool-permissions.md)
  - [VS Code workflow controls](doc/arch/adr/0010-add-real-time-vs-code-workflow-controls-that-show-routing.md)

## Architecture

- [Configuration and routing](docs/architecture/configuration-routing-and-providers.md): roles, aliases, providers, and routing order
- [Codex operations](docs/operations/codex-provider.md): auth, billing, updates, failures, and quota-free validation
- [Claude operations](docs/operations/claude-code-provider.md): auth, billing, updates, failures, and quota-free validation
- [OpenRouter operations](docs/operations/openrouter-provider.md): credentials, budgets, offline vs live
- [Grok ACP operations](docs/operations/grok-acp-provider.md): official provider launch boundary
- [Terminal integration](docs/architecture/grok-build-terminal-integration.md): Grok Build fork and ACP boundary
- [Headless CLI](doc/arch/domain/cli-surface.md): commands, JSON output, and stable exit codes
- [Local operations](doc/arch/operations/operations.md): runtime layout, recovery, and backup
- [Local SLOs](doc/arch/slo/service-level-objectives.md): durability, latency, and security gates
- [Observability](doc/arch/observability/observability.md): metrics, logs, traces, and privacy rules
- [Privacy threats](doc/arch/threat-model/privacy-threat-model.md): LINDDUN analysis and mitigations

## Speckit Workflow

Run `speckit status`, then execute only the phase from `speckit next`.
The lifecycle is `specify` → `clarify` → `plan` → `tasks` → `analyze` →
`implement`. Use `speckit validate` before commits, `speckit verify` for
Gherkin bindings, `speckit spec score` for corpus health, and `speckit missing`
for the ranked advisory queue. Never edit `doc/.specify/` directly or bypass
the guard.
